title: 7 Small Habits That Put a Godly Man Back in Charge of His Day
caption:
7 small habits that put a godly man back in charge of his day. None of them take more than ten minutes.

He makes the bed before he checks the phone. He answers texts on his own schedule, not the sender's. He says the true sentence instead of the easy one.

He does the workout on the day he doesn't feel it. He closes the laptop at the hour he said he would. He prays before he problem-solves.

He ends the night the way he planned it, not the way the day dragged him into. The last hour is still his to run.

#christianmen #godlymanhood #discipline #dailyhabits #selfcontrol
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
